levels.surface: إسحاق بن إبراهيم بن حبيب بن الشهيد

notes: «ح» separates two branches; the text writes Abu Uthman and Ibn Mas'ud once after the last «ح», so they are the shared tail (rule 3)
The convergence point is not written: «أبي» (Mu'tamir's father) is kept as a relation and is not identified from other sources
The first branch stops at Sulayman al-Taymi in the text; the tail is placed after both branches as written
